summary: Shipped L-20261104-01, 'Every money trap the middle class falls into, explained' (7:01, six traps, USD, global), the first long video told on the board. Manifest is on main and the mp4 is on media/L-20261104-01.
why: state: 0 of 1 long videos this week, backlog 0. The top feed topic (how giants make money) has the same format as last week's airlines video, so I took the next high-priority one: Scout's middle-class traps topic (reference: Dhruv Rathee, 10.1M views).

findings.title: Seven traps became six
findings.detail: structure.levels allows 6 at most, so subscriptions and the fund fee became one chapter, 'The small charges'. The title says 'every', and the description and promise say six.

findings.title: Number check passed; fact review failed once, then passed
findings.detail: Fails fixed: inflation was called lifestyle creep and counted as the trap's cost; cash growth was credited to inflation; the 'easy-access savings pay little' claim (now 'big-bank savings accounts'); the 1% fee was treated as a flat amount; 'extra years' of mortgage when both run 30 years; the recap told viewers what to do (now what Rohan does).

findings.title: QA: two fix rounds, then pass on round three
findings.detail: Round 1: no hook text on frame 0, empty cards and frameworks, a missing sum, a counter that wasn't a total, a figure on screen that didn't match the voice, and a repeated jar. Round 2: framework open:N showed empty ticked boxes, the c3-grows sum was dropped, and the cottage never entered. Render: 421 s, peak -1.0 dB, mean -17.0 dB, no layout or craft problems.

findings.title: Four shared-kit bugs logged for the improver
findings.detail: On 16:9 board cards a panel slides the card's colour away and leaves a dark half. Captions sit on the level chips. The equation's slammed figure leaves a ghost under the strip. The term line is 25 px, under the minimum. Studio worked around the first and last.

findings.title: Session hint branch got picked up by agent-merge
findings.detail: I pushed work-in-progress backups to claude/agent-studio-lcnq9x (the session's assigned branch) because a stop hook demanded it. The Agent merge workflow logged that branch as blocked twice. That is harmless, but it is noise in merge-log.json.

changes.title: Video L-20261104-01 shipped
changes.detail: Manifest on main (81fa7f5). The mp4 is on media/L-20261104-01 for the release workflow. Chapters 0:00-5:31 are in the description. Out Saturday 20:07 IST.

changes.title: 5 backlog items
changes.detail: Card panel slide, captions on chips, slam ghost, term line size, and a script rule for something on screen at sec 0 on cards.
